purpose: Observed second-target approach, right-side passage and outer-board proximity; pure controller regression only.
limitations: Raw scan objects are copied unchanged; numeric lidar data only, no images or credentials.
State and lidar were read sequentially. recorded_decision explicitly keeps its own source scan sequence and must not be treated as a decision for the paired scan.
Tests use an explicit offline receipt model derived from publication intervals; saved actuator feedback describes the old physical run, not a new closed-loop result.
First pass is historical evidence; the second pass must still be established from current complete support and cannot be assumed from this fixture.

Only recorded even-sequence samples 680 through 704 are present; missing intervening scans, including 701, are not reconstructed. Preparation tracker can confirm on real 680/682/684 before the tested decision window.

At the saved 5 Hz cadence the 696-to-698 bearing jump cannot be associated as a new full support; a conditional stage replay may only retain an earlier earned return command there. It does not claim to reproduce the original 10 Hz identity history.
